Four merged pull requests since 2026-04-16 added or removed a line containing `encounterProviders` under `packages/esm-service-queues-app`. Listed by merge date, newest first (times UTC):

1. **#2824**, O3-6098, merged 2026-10-14. Its line in `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/constants.ts` (line 24) changed. The line is the visit custom representation string, which includes `encounterProviders`.
2. **#2600**, O3-5763, merged 2026-08-28. It removed `encounterProviders` lines from `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/current-visit/current-visit.resource.ts` (line 15), `src/current-visit/hooks/useVitalsConceptMetadata.ts` (lines 63–64) and `src/current-visit/visit-details/current-visit-details.component.tsx` (line 46).
3. **#2583**, O3-5693, merged 2026-07-29. It removed a line in `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/hooks/useQueueEntries.ts` (line 9), the queue entry representation that requested `encounterProviders`.
4. **#2541**, O3-5679, merged 2026-06-08. It changed `encounterProviders` lines in `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/past-visit/past-visit-details/past-visit-summary.component.tsx` (lines 67–68 removed, 80–81 and 97 added).

Excluded: **#2623** (O3-5812, merged 2026-07-16) also matched, but only under `e2e/commands/encounter-operations.ts`, which is outside `packages/esm-service-queues-app`.

Method and caveats:
- I searched the default-branch history with Falkon's `search_diffs` for the term `encounterProviders`, both added and removed sides, from 2026-04-16 on. The search returned no truncation or coverage gaps.
- I did not know the pinned head, so I used the default branch HEAD. Merge commits are not searched by that tool, but each PR's merge commit is the squash commit on main, so this should not drop any PR.
- Merge dates come from each PR's `mergedAt` field.
